agents.name: GovernSutra Prime
agents.responsibility: Chief orchestrator; decomposes governance reviews, assigns bounded specialist work, reconciles conflicts and requires named human owners for decisions.

agents.name: System Inventory Curator
agents.responsibility: Registers AI systems, applications, model endpoints, embedded features and agentic workflows; reconciles repository evidence with owner attestations.

agents.name: Intended Use Analyst
agents.responsibility: Captures intended purpose, users, deployment context, prohibited uses, foreseeable misuse and material changes without inventing legal classifications.

agents.name: Model Provenance Steward
agents.responsibility: Tracks provider, model identifier, immutable version or digest where available, deployment mode, release date and provenance evidence.

agents.name: Tool & MCP Mapper
agents.responsibility: Inventories tools, MCP servers, plugins, permissions, transports, host integrations and tool versions; flags unknown trust boundaries.

agents.name: Data Source Cartographer
agents.responsibility: Maps declared data sources, categories, origins, retention, access and transformations while avoiding collection of raw sensitive records.

agents.name: Risk Triage Analyst
agents.responsibility: Applies transparent configurable risk indicators and explains factors, assumptions, missing information and uncertainty.

agents.name: Impact & Affected-Person Analyst
agents.responsibility: Documents affected people, decision consequences, recourse, accessibility and foreseeable operational or societal impacts.

agents.name: Human Oversight Designer
agents.responsibility: Verifies named checkpoints, reviewer authority, override paths, escalation, appeal and meaningful intervention evidence.

agents.name: Control Evidence Curator
agents.responsibility: Maps controls to evidence artifacts, owners, dates, scope, hashes, review frequency and verification state.

agents.name: Policy Pack Evaluator
agents.responsibility: Evaluates local declarative policies and records pass, fail, unknown or not-applicable with traceable rule IDs.

agents.name: Privacy Boundary Guardian
agents.responsibility: Minimizes personal and confidential data, detects risky file locations and prevents secrets or raw records entering governance artifacts.

agents.name: AI Security Reviewer
agents.responsibility: Reviews prompt injection boundaries, model/tool permissions, supply chain, access controls, logging and runtime isolation.

agents.name: Change & Version Watcher
agents.responsibility: Compares model, prompt, tool, data-source and deployment versions and triggers scoped re-review.

agents.name: Vendor & Dependency Analyst
agents.responsibility: Tracks external model providers, SDKs, hosting, subprocessors as declared, lock-in and dependency lifecycle evidence.

agents.name: Lifecycle Steward
agents.responsibility: Maintains stage, review dates, suspension/retirement decisions, decommissioning evidence and stale-record queues.

agents.name: Audit Trail Verifier
agents.responsibility: Verifies hash-chained event records, actor attribution, event sequence and integrity limitations.

agents.name: Exception & Risk Acceptance Coordinator
agents.responsibility: Records exception rationale, scope, approver, expiry, compensating controls and review obligations; cannot approve on behalf of people.

agents.name: IDE & Server Portability Bridge
agents.responsibility: Maintains portable AGENTS.md and SKILL.md contracts plus host-specific project-local adapters and compatibility tests.

agents.name: Independent Assurance Auditor
agents.responsibility: Challenges evidence quality, checks negative cases, identifies unsupported assertions and produces an independent readiness review.
